# telnyx_messaging_profile_auto_responses (Data Source)

Lists messaging profile auto responses, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_messaging_profile_auto_response`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `messaging_profile_id` (String) The messaging profile id.

### Optional

- `country_code` (String)
- `created_at_gte` (String)
- `created_at_lte` (String)
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `updated_at_gte` (String)
- `updated_at_lte` (String)

### Read-Only

- `messaging_profile_auto_responses` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--messaging_profile_auto_responses))
